chalk.label: Chalk
chalk.desc: Highest probabilities, one player per team. RB-heavy, shortest payout, fewest misses.

balanced.label: Balanced
balanced.desc: No position is more than half the legs and every ticket carries at least one WR. A few points less likely than chalk, paid like a real parlay.

air.label: Air (singles only)
air.desc: Receivers only. Shown for reference: WR/TE anytime TDs are singles under the Week 9 rule (1 of 8 hit; ledger pattern), not ticket legs.
